024/**
025 * Swing-based graphical shell for the text adventure: log area, text field, directional shortcut
026 * buttons, and an optional room image.
027 *
028 * <p>Implements {@link ActionListener} so both the entry field and buttons forward normalized
029 * commands to the {@link GameEngine}.
030 *
031 * @author Michael Kolling
032 * @version 1.0 (Jan 2003) DB edited (2023)
033 */
034public class UserInterface implements ActionListener {
035    /** Top-level window hosting all components. */
036    private JFrame aMyFrame;
037
038    /** Single-line input where the player types commands. */
039    private JTextField aEntryField;
040
041    /** Scrollable transcript of game output. */
042    private JTextArea aLog;
043
044    /** Displays the current room image when available. */
045    private JLabel aImage;
046
047    /** Displays a map image (if provided by the engine). */
048    private JLabel aMap;
049
050    /** Sends {@code go north} when clicked. */

052
053    /** Sends {@code go south} when clicked. */

055
056    /** Sends {@code go east} when clicked. */
057    private JButton aButtonGoEast;
058
059    /** Sends {@code go west} when clicked. */
060    private JButton aButtonGoWest;
061
062    /** Sends {@code go up} when clicked. */
063    private JButton aButtonGoUp;
064
065    /** Sends {@code go down} when clicked. */
066    private JButton aButtonGoDown;
067
068    /** Sends {@code help} when clicked. */
069    private JButton aButtonHelp;
070
071    /** Sends {@code back} when clicked. */
072    private JButton aButtonBack;
073
074    /** Sends {@code quit} when clicked. */
075    private JButton aButtonQuit;
076
077    /** Progress bar shown during asset download at startup. */
078    private JProgressBar aProgressBar;
079
080    /** Parser used to turn user input into commands. */
081    private Parser aParser;
082
083    /** Game engine receiving parsed commands from this UI. */
084    private GameEngine aEngine;
085
086    /** Main exploration UI panel */

088
089    /** Battle UI panel */

107    /**
108     * Builds the frame, layout, and listeners, storing the engine for later callbacks.
109     *
110     * @param pGameEngine the non-{@code null} game engine that will interpret commands
111     */
112    public UserInterface(final GameEngine pGameEngine) {
113        this.aEngine = pGameEngine;
114        this.aParser = new Parser();
115        this.createGUI();
116        this.createBattlePanel();
117    } // UserInterface(.)

119    /**
120     * Appends text to the log without a trailing newline and scrolls to the end.
121     *
122     * @param pText fragment to append (may be empty)
123     */
124    public void print(final String pText) {
125        this.aLog.append(pText);
126        this.aLog.setCaretPosition(this.aLog.getDocument().getLength());
127    } // print(.)
128
129    /**
130     * Appends a line of text to the log, then scrolls to the end.
131     *
132     * @param pText full line content (a newline is added automatically)
133     */
134    public void println(final String pText) {
135        this.print(pText + "\n");
136    } // println(.)
137
138    /**
139     * Loads an image from the classpath (typically under {@code images/}) and sets it on the north
140     * label, packing the frame to fit.
141     *
142     * @param pImageName resource path relative to the class loader root
143     */
144    public void showImage(final String pImageName) {
145        String vImagePath = "Images/" + pImageName;
146        URL vImageURL = this.getClass().getClassLoader().getResource(vImagePath);
147        if (vImageURL == null) {
148            System.out.println("Image not found: " + vImagePath);
149        } else {
150            ImageIcon vIcon = new ImageIcon(vImageURL);
151            this.aImage.setIcon(vIcon);
152        }
153    } // showImage(.)
154

172    /**
173     * Enables or disables keyboard entry in the command field and toggles caret blink.
174     *
175     * @param pOnOff {@code true} to allow typing; {@code false} to freeze input at game end
176     */
177    public void enable(final boolean pOnOff) {
178        this.aEntryField.setEditable(pOnOff);
179        if (pOnOff) {
180            this.aEntryField.getCaret().setBlinkRate(500);
181            this.aEntryField.addActionListener(this);
182        } else {
183            this.aEntryField.getCaret().setBlinkRate(0);
184            this.aEntryField.removeActionListener(this);
185        }
186    } // enable(.)

188    /** Lays out components, registers listeners, and shows the window. */
189    private void createGUI() {
190        this.aMyFrame = new JFrame("Pokémon Delta Emerald");
191        this.aEntryField = new JTextField(34);
192
193        this.aLog = new JTextArea();
194        this.aLog.setEditable(false);
195        JScrollPane vListScroller = new JScrollPane(this.aLog);
196        vListScroller.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(200, 200));
197        vListScroller.setMinimumSize(new Dimension(100, 100));
198
199        this.aImage = new JLabel();
200        this.aImage.setHorizontalAlignment(JLabel.CENTER);
201        this.aImage.setVerticalAlignment(JLabel.CENTER);
202
203        this.aProgressBar = new JProgressBar(0, 100);
204        this.aProgressBar.setStringPainted(true);
205        this.aProgressBar.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(200, 50));
206        this.aProgressBar.setForeground(new Color(76, 175, 80));
207        this.aProgressBar.setBackground(new Color(50, 50, 60));
208        this.aProgressBar.setValue(100);
209
210        this.aMap = new JLabel();
211
212        this.aButtonGoUp = new JButton("go up");
213        this.aButtonGoNorth = new JButton("go north");
214        this.aButtonGoDown = new JButton("go down");
215        this.aButtonGoWest = new JButton("go west");
216        this.aButtonGoEast = new JButton("go east");
217        this.aButtonBack = new JButton("go back");
218        this.aButtonHelp = new JButton("help");
219        this.aButtonGoSouth = new JButton("go south");
220        this.aButtonQuit = new JButton("quit");
221
222        JPanel vButtonPanel = new JPanel();
223        vButtonPanel.setLayout(new GridLayout(3, 3));
224        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonGoUp);
225        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonGoNorth);
226        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonGoDown);
227        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonGoWest);
228        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonBack);
229        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonGoEast);
230        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonHelp);
231        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonGoSouth);
232        vButtonPanel.add(this.aButtonQuit);
233
234        // Create exploration panel
235        this.aExplorationPanel = new JPanel();
236        this.aExplorationPanel.setLayout(new BorderLayout());
237        this.aExplorationPanel.setBackground(new Color(30, 30, 40));
238        this.aExplorationPanel.add(this.aImage, BorderLayout.CENTER);
239
240        JPanel vSouthPanel = new JPanel();
241        vSouthPanel.setLayout(new BorderLayout());
242        vSouthPanel.setPreferredSize(new Dimension(0, 400));
243
244        vSouthPanel.add(vListScroller, BorderLayout.CENTER);
245        vSouthPanel.add(this.aEntryField, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
246        vSouthPanel.add(vButtonPanel, BorderLayout.WEST);
247        vSouthPanel.add(this.aMap, BorderLayout.EAST);
248
249        this.aExplorationPanel.add(aProgressBar, BorderLayout.NORTH);
250        this.aExplorationPanel.add(vSouthPanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
251
252        // Create battle panel
253        this.createBattlePanel();
254
255        // Add exploration panel first (visible by default)
256        this.aMyFrame.getContentPane().add(this.aExplorationPanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
257
258        this.aEntryField.addActionListener(this);
259        this.aButtonGoNorth.addActionListener(this);
260        this.aButtonGoSouth.addActionListener(this);
261        this.aButtonGoEast.addActionListener(this);
262        this.aButtonGoWest.addActionListener(this);
263        this.aButtonGoUp.addActionListener(this);
264        this.aButtonGoDown.addActionListener(this);
265        this.aButtonBack.addActionListener(this);
266        this.aButtonQuit.addActionListener(this);
267        this.aButtonHelp.addActionListener(this);
268
269        this.aMyFrame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
270        this.aMyFrame.setVisible(true);
271        this.aEntryField.requestFocus();
272        this.aMyFrame.setExtendedState(JFrame.MAXIMIZED_BOTH);

344    /** Switches from exploration mode to battle mode. */
345    public void startBattle() {
346        this.aMyFrame.getContentPane().remove(this.aExplorationPanel);
347        this.aMyFrame.getContentPane().add(this.aBattlePanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
348        this.aBattlePanel.setVisible(true);
349        this.aMyFrame.revalidate();
350        this.aMyFrame.repaint();
351    } // startBattle()
352
353    /** Switches from battle mode back to exploration mode. */
354    public void endBattle() {
355        this.aMyFrame.getContentPane().remove(this.aBattlePanel);
356        this.aMyFrame.getContentPane().add(this.aExplorationPanel, BorderLayout.CENTER);
357        this.aExplorationPanel.setVisible(true);
358        this.aMyFrame.revalidate();
359        this.aMyFrame.repaint();
360    } // endBattle()

362    /**
363     * Shows player's Pokemon image (left side). PNG files are scaled to 640x400, GIF files are
364     * displayed raw.
365     *
366     * @param pImageName resource path for player pokemon
367     */
368    public void showPlayerPokemonImage(final String pImageName) {
369        String vImagePath = "Images/" + pImageName;
370        URL vImageURL = this.getClass().getClassLoader().getResource(vImagePath);
371        if (vImageURL == null) {
372            System.out.println("Player pokemon image not found: " + vImagePath);
373        } else {
374            if (pImageName.endsWith(".png")) {
375                ImageIcon vIcon = new ImageIcon(vImageURL);
376                this.aPlayerPokemonImage.setIcon(new ImageIcon(vIcon.getImage().getScaledInstance(960, 904, java.awt.Image.SCALE_SMOOTH)));
377            } else {
378                ImageIcon vIcon = new ImageIcon(vImageURL);
379                vIcon.getImage().flush();
380                this.aPlayerPokemonImage.setIcon(vIcon);
381            }
382        }
383    } // showPlayerPokemonImage()
384

477    /**
478     * Dispatches button clicks as canned commands, or reads the text field on Enter.
479     *
480     * @param pE the originating AWT event (button or text field)
481     */
482    @Override
483    public void actionPerformed(final ActionEvent pE) {
484        if (this.aButtonGoNorth.equals(pE.getSource())) {
485            this.println("\n\n> go north\n");
486            this.aParser.getCommand("go north").execute(this.aEngine);
487        } else if (this.aButtonGoSouth.equals(pE.getSource())) { // actionPerformed()
488            this.println("\n\n> go south\n");
489            this.aParser.getCommand("go south").execute(this.aEngine);
490        } else if (this.aButtonGoEast.equals(pE.getSource())) {
491            this.println("\n\n> go east\n");
492            this.aParser.getCommand("go east").execute(this.aEngine);
493        } else if (this.aButtonGoWest.equals(pE.getSource())) {
494            this.println("\n\n> go west\n");
495            this.aParser.getCommand("go west").execute(this.aEngine);
496        } else if (this.aButtonGoUp.equals(pE.getSource())) {
497            this.println("\n\n> go up\n");
498            this.aParser.getCommand("go up").execute(this.aEngine);
499        } else if (this.aButtonGoDown.equals(pE.getSource())) {
500            this.println("\n\n> go down\n");
501            this.aParser.getCommand("go down").execute(this.aEngine);
502        } else if (this.aButtonBack.equals(pE.getSource())) {
503            this.println("\n\n> back\n");
504            this.aParser.getCommand("back").execute(this.aEngine);
505        } else if (this.aButtonQuit.equals(pE.getSource())) {
506            this.println("\n\n> quit\n");
507            this.aParser.getCommand("quit").execute(this.aEngine);
508        } else if (this.aButtonHelp.equals(pE.getSource())) {
509            this.println("\n\n> help\n");
510            this.aParser.getCommand("help").execute(this.aEngine);
511        } else {
512            String vInput = this.aEntryField.getText();
513            this.println("\n\n> " + vInput + "\n");
514            Command vCommand = this.aParser.getCommand(vInput);
515            if (vCommand == null) {
516                this.println("I don't know what you mean...");
517            } else {
518                vCommand.execute(this.aEngine);
519            }
520            this.aEntryField.setText("");
521        }
522    } // actionPerformed(.)
